variants.name: 01-card-cut
variants.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Design a distinctive bespoke typographic logo for CARDMYSTIC, a Magic: The Gathering card search and deckbuilding brand whose existing symbol is a curved pointed wizard hat. This is custom lettering drawn by a brand designer, NOT a specimen of a standard typeface. Exact only text "CARDMYSTIC" spelled C A R D M Y S T I C, uppercase, one horizontal wordmark. Make the typography itself recognizable and ownable. Pure white solid lettering on a completely flat near-black #111118 background. Landscape canvas, wordmark large with comfortable margins. Flat vector-like artwork, sharp smooth edges, careful optical kerning, all letters readable and distinct at small sizes. No extra text, labels, symbols outside the lettering, standalone icon, illustration, gradients, shadows, textures, distressing, 3D, mockup, glow or color. Do not use a generic geometric sans or Roman serif unchanged. Design direction: bespoke card-cut lettering. Draw a sturdy moderately condensed sans wordmark with subtly rectangular curves, referencing rounded playing cards. Create a repeated distinctive asymmetric diagonal corner cut across C, D, R, S and the last C. The D counter must read like a tilted rounded rectangular card-shaped cutout, and repeat that same diagonal angle in the R bowl and A counter. The M has an unusually deep precise V-shaped valley, echoed by the Y junction. Crucially this is not generic sci-fi or stencil lettering: strokes remain continuous, approachable and polished. A small family of consistent custom cuts makes the whole word feel designed as one logo. Retain generous internal counters. No disconnected floating bits or separate card icons.
